title: Correction to: Effects of the genetic polymorphisms of TAS2R43 and TAS2R46 on receptors’ function and on perceived bitterness of caffeine by human subjects
content: This is a correction to: Rena Numabe, Alon Rainish, Masha Y Niv, Hiroo Imai, Effects of the genetic polymorphisms of TAS2R43 and TAS2R46 on receptors’ function and on perceived bitterness of caffeine by human subjects, Chemical Senses, Volume 50, 2025, bjaf027, https://doi.org/10.1093/chemse/bjaf027.
